user_query: My company is organizing a music festival and we need to book artists for the lineup. Can you provide me with the top tracks of various artists from Soundcloud? Additionally, fetch the related artist information from Shazam to create a diverse and exciting lineup.

TaskList.description: Fetch top tracks of various artists from SoundCloud.
Get related artist information from Shazam based on the top tracks obtained from SoundCloud.
Compile the top tracks and related artist information into a presentation for the music festival lineup.
